data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 fails to provide the evidence that distinguishes genuine reliability gain from mere checklist compliance. Its mechanism relies on hypothetical failure cases (a 'blind spot' where the panel confidently produces a wrong answer because the checklist was followed perfectly but was insufficient), which demonstrates the hazard of checklist compliance, but it never identifies an observation within a single evaluation that would separate a genuine reliability gain from rote compliance that merely tracks the right answer.
